g.text: Two-layer energy-balance model (C = 7.3 and 106 W yr m⁻² K⁻¹, feedback 1.13 - 0.035 T W m⁻² K⁻¹, exchange 0.73 W m⁻² K⁻¹) with red-
noise variability. Emulators map forcing smoothed over 1-400 years to warming; trained on historical, 1 %/yr to 2×CO₂ and abrupt 2×CO₂
